Here is the wrap-up recap for **The Eldergulch Tapes – Season 3 ("The Long Shaft")** Halloween week campaign (`om8vk`), which ran from **Sunday, October 24, 2027 through Sunday, October 31, 2027** (Mountain Time).

### Overall Campaign Summary
- **Total Spend:** **$699.83** (out of your $700.00 budget — 99.98% utilization)
- **Total Impressions:** **586,063**
- **Total Link Clicks:** **457** (to `https://eldergulch.com/season3`)
- **Total Engagements:** **4,200** (including 97 likes, 2 reposts, 1 reply)
- **Average Cost Per Link Click (CPC):** **$1.53**

---

### Performance by Ad Group (Line Item)
Because X did not have a conversion pixel on the landing page, all ad groups were set up under the **Website Clicks** objective (`goal=LINK_CLICKS`, billed per link click) targeting listeners in the **United States**. Over the course of the week, we monitored performance daily and shifted budget toward the highest-converting audience segments:

| Ad Group | Targeting Strategy | Status | Spend | Impressions | Link Clicks | Avg. CPC |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| **AG2 (`qt4ep`)** | **High-Intent Keywords** (*horror podcast, audio drama, fiction podcast, scary/creepy/spooky/paranormal/halloween podcast, found footage*) | Completed | $403.74 | 280,124 | 294 | $1.37 |
| **AG1 (`ke0ko`)** | **Core Interests** (*Podcasts, Movies & TV / Horror & Thriller, Streaming*) | Completed | $272.31 | 286,066 | 155 | $1.76 |
| **AG3 (`2a2do`)** | **Follower Lookalikes & Adjacent Genre Interests** (*@TheEldergulchTa lookalikes, Sci-Fi & Fantasy, Crime*) | Paused Day 2 | $23.78 | 19,873 | 8 | $2.97 |
| **Total** | | | **$699.83** | **586,063** | **457** | **$1.53** |

#### How We Managed It Through the Week
1. **Early Testing (Days 1–2):** We launched all three ad groups with all four approved posts to test where high-intent podcast listeners were clicking most efficiently.
2. **Pruning & Scaling (Day 2 Onward):** AG3 (Broad Lookalikes & Sci-Fi/Crime) showed a significantly higher cost per click ($2.97 CPC) and lower click-through rate, so we paused it after Day 2 and reallocated its remaining budget into **AG2 (Keywords)** and **AG1 (Horror & Podcasts Interests)**.
3. **Expanding High-Intent Keywords:** As AG2 emerged as our strongest driver of traffic ($1.37 CPC), we expanded its keyword list mid-week to capture seasonal search and conversation intent (*spooky podcast, halloween podcast, horror audio drama, paranormal podcast*) and steadily scaled its daily budget through Halloween night.

---

### Performance by Promoted Post
All four approved posts were tested across the ad groups:

| Post ID | Post Copy Preview | Spend | Impressions | Link Clicks | CTR | Avg. CPC |
| :--- | :--- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| `2245419913839017173` | *"Season 3 of The Eldergulch Tapes is here. A Colorado mining town went silent in 1893..."* | $202.27 | 142,635 | 136 | 0.095% | $1.49 |
| `2245782301702619459` | *"Ever heard a mine shaft breathe? Lights off. Headphones on. Press play..."* | $173.19 | 153,577 | 110 | 0.072% | $1.57 |
| `2245963495636986737` | *"Eight nights to Halloween, eight new episodes. Season 3 of The Eldergulch Tapes drops..."* | $175.83 | 141,538 | 106 | 0.075% | $1.66 |
| `2245601107772237999` | *"The Eldergulch Tapes: a fictional horror audio drama set in a dead Colorado mining town..."* | $148.52 | 148,313 | 105 | 0.071% | $1.41 |

* **`2245419913839017173`** (the organic launch announcement mentioning Spotify & Apple Podcasts) drove the highest volume of link clicks (**136 clicks**, **0.095% CTR**), performing especially well in the keyword-targeted ad group.
* **`2245601107772237999`** (the descriptive US streaming callout) achieved the lowest cost per link click (**$1.41 CPC**, **105 clicks**).
* **`2245782301702619459`** (*"Ever heard a mine shaft breathe?"*) and **`2245963495636986737`** (*"Eight nights to Halloween"*) both performed strongly with core horror and podcast interest audiences, contributing **110** and **106** link clicks respectively.

Hope Season 3 had a massive Halloween week on the streaming platforms! Let me know if you need any additional breakdowns.
